_rationale: Cash skips both the stochastic shock AND the black-swan overlay. Year 0: cash starts at $100k. Growth applies yield-only (0 here). Spending $20k → cash drains to $80k. The black-swan in 2026 (stock×0.5, bond×0.5) MUST NOT touch the cash account. If the bypass were missing, cash would be cut in half to $50k post-growth, then withdraw $20k → end at $30k. The expected $80k proves the bypass holds.

pathValues.note: After year-0 yield (0) and withdrawal (20k). If black-swan touched cash, this would be 30k.
